taxpayer.label: Letter to Taxpayer
taxpayer.description: Intimations, requests for documents/clarification, reminders, replies to taxpayer representations, refund/registration/recovery correspondence.
example_instructions: Request the taxpayer to furnish documents listed in the source within 15 days
Reply to the taxpayer's representation dated __ rejecting the request with reasons
Reminder for payment of confirmed demand as per OIO
checklist: Legal name AND trade name of the taxpayer exactly as in the source
GSTIN (15 characters, copy character-by-character), PAN if given
Complete principal place of business address, email ID, mobile
Taxpayer's letter / representation / ARN number and date being referred to
Tax period(s) / financial year(s) involved
Issue in one line, and the specific documents or action required
Amounts involved: tax, interest, penalty, split by CGST / SGST / IGST / Cess
Statutory provisions under which the communication is issued (as cited in source)
Time limit given to the taxpayer for reply / compliance
Jurisdictional Range / Division of the taxpayer

appeal_review.label: Appeal / Review (OIO / OIA)
appeal_review.description: Review of Orders-in-Original / Orders-in-Appeal, proposals to file appeal before Commissioner (Appeals) / GSTAT / High Court, forwarding of review orders and appeal papers, acceptance of orders.
example_instructions: Forward the review proposal for filing appeal under Section 107(2) against the OIO
Intimate acceptance of the Order-in-Appeal with reasons
Forward APL-03 application papers to the Commissioner (Appeals)
checklist: Order No. (OIO / OIA), date of order, DIN of the order
Name and designation of the adjudicating / appellate authority who passed the order
DATE OF RECEIPT / COMMUNICATION of the order in this office (separately from the order date)
Taxpayer legal name, trade name, GSTIN, address
SCN number and date from which the order arises; period involved
Demand proposed in SCN vs demand confirmed / dropped in the order: tax, interest, penalty for CGST / SGST / IGST / Cess
Key findings of the authority (paragraph numbers of the order)
Grounds on which the order appears not legal or proper (only those supported by the source)

Provision for review / appeal: Section 107(2) (against OIO, to Appellate Authority) or Section 112(3) (against OIA, to Appellate Tribunal) of the CGST Act, 2017, and corresponding State Act provision if cited
Limitation: last date for review / filing, with the date it is counted from
Amount in dispute for checking monetary limits for departmental appeals (if forum is GSTAT / High Court / Supreme Court)
Review order / Committee details, if any

court_writ.label: Court / Writ Matter
court_writ.description: Writ petitions, counter affidavits, para-wise comments, instructions to Standing Counsel, compliance with court orders (Madras High Court, Madurai Bench etc.).
example_instructions: Forward para-wise comments on the writ petition to the Standing Counsel
Request the Standing Counsel to file counter affidavit before the next hearing date
Report compliance with the High Court order to the Commissioner
checklist: Court and Bench (e.g. High Court of Judicature at Madras, Madurai Bench)
Case number with year (W.P.(MD) No. ___ of 20__, W.M.P. (MD) No.) and date of filing
Petitioner name (and GSTIN if a taxpayer); list of respondents with respondent numbers; which respondent is this office
Impugned order / notice: number, date, authority
Prayer sought by the petitioner
Interim orders / directions of the Court with date, and next hearing date
Name of the Standing Counsel / Senior Panel Counsel, if mentioned
Department's stand: factual and legal points, with provisions of law relied upon
Deadline for filing counter / compliance

scn_adjudication.label: SCN / Adjudication
scn_adjudication.description: Correspondence relating to Show Cause Notices under Sections 73/74/74A/76 etc., personal hearing intimations, reminders for reply, DRC-01A/DRC-01 related letters, adjournments.
example_instructions: Intimate personal hearing on __ at __ hrs for the SCN
Second reminder to file reply to the SCN
Reject request for further adjournment citing Section 75(5)
checklist: SCN number, date, DIN, and the issuing authority
Section under which SCN is issued (73 / 74 for FY 2017-18 to 2023-24; 74A for FY 2024-25 onwards; 76; 122; 129/130 etc.)
Taxpayer legal name, trade name, GSTIN, address, email
Period / financial year(s) covered
Demand proposed: tax, interest, penalty for CGST / SGST / IGST / Cess
Issue(s) in brief
Date by which reply was due; whether reply received (date)
Personal hearing dates already fixed and number of adjournments already granted (Section 75(5): not more than three times)
Proposed PH date, time, venue / virtual link
Time limit for passing order (Section 73(10) / 74(10) / 74A(7), with any extension notified)

admin.label: Administrative / Inter-office
admin.description: Letters to Commissionerate / Zone / Board / Division / Range, reports, statements, RTI replies, general correspondence.
example_instructions: Submit the monthly report on legal cases called for in the reference
Request the Division to furnish the status of the cases listed in the reference
Reply to the RTI application within the statutory time
checklist: Reference letter number, date and issuing office being replied to
What exactly is called for / requested, and in what format
Due date given in the reference
Facts, figures and status to be reported (copy numbers exactly)
Whom the letter is addressed to, through whom, and copies to whom
Enclosures to be sent
For RTI: application number, date of receipt, information sought, sections of the RTI Act, 2005 applicable, appellate authority details
